run_resolver_component_tests: run c-ares DNS resolver component tests against a local DNS server with configurable test binary and records
run_wait_until_dns_server_is_up: run a health check loop that verifies the local DNS server is reachable over TCP and UDP
run_test_runner_log: run the test runner logging function to write timestamped messages to stderr
run_python_args: run the cross-platform Python argument wrapper to prepend sys.executable on Windows
run_quit_on_signal: run the signal handler that kills the DNS server subprocess and exits on SIGINT or SIGTERM
